description: desired.v2 §2.4, §2.6 to §2.10: one target's role, and the steps it takes, in order -> what each step does, and the report after the last, in the profile's reading (reports.json). Computed twice by two scripts of the text's drafter that share no code, kept out of the repository, and never blessed. A step is one of: {sample: {from, kind, version, revision?, document? | bytes?}}, a sample or an answer received from either path (§2.5), from "owner" (the author's own put, delete or snapshot entry) or "archive" (an archive's last-known, §2.9), its kind "put" (a put, or a live entry) or "delete" (a delete, or a tombstone), its version <run>/<seq> (§2.4) or null for a sample with no envelope, revision the document type's own when it carries one, and a put's document, decoded JSON holding integers and strings only, equal when its members and values are (v1 §2.7's comparison, which v1's order.json pins), or its bytes in hex, equal byte for byte; {sample: {from: "owner", kind: "no_entry", snapshot: {run, asof}}}, a member's snapshot with no entry, its header's run and its asof (§2.8); {finish: "done" | {refused: Refusal} | {failed: Refusal}}, the running act ends, applied whole (a put converged, a delete or a snapshot with no entry reverted), refused whole, or failed partway (a refusal of a revert is read as a failure), a Refusal being {code, pointer?, detail?} with its indices; {finish: "check"}, the running act's put ends as §2.4's bound judges it: done when its revision is at most 4,294,967,295 or it has none, else refused whole, {code: invalid}; {call: true}, the target's own operation changed what is in force; {restart: true}, a new process of the target, holding nothing. The target starts holding nothing, its report {source: baseline, outcome: not_acted, last_known: false}. Two runs are the same when their widths and values are. The target remembers, per run, the highest seq it acted on or adopted a version of, or the asof of a snapshot with no entry it reverted on where that is higher; no case names more than 16 runs. expect.steps, for a put or a delete: unstamped (no envelope); older (a seq below the remembered run's highest, or at or below a remembered asof, or below the one held waiting's in its run); same_version (a seq equal to the remembered run's highest, or to the one held waiting's), or confirmed where that version is the one held, or held waiting, came from an archive, and this delivery is the owner's; held (admitted while an act runs: it replaces what waits); and, admitted otherwise, adopted when the target has acted on or adopted a version in this process and the last of them has the same document (two equal documents, or two that are no document: a delete, or a snapshot with no entry), else act or revert, the act starting. For a snapshot with no entry: no_verdict (the target holds no put's version of the snapshot's run: nothing held, a delete held, or another run), older (it holds one whose seq is above the asof), each judged of the version last acted on or adopted, the running act's while one runs, then of the one held waiting; else held while an act runs, or revert. For finish: done, or adopted, act or revert for a version held waiting, as it starts. called; restarted. expect.report is the report after the last step, as §2.10 builds it: observed the last version acted on or adopted, with its revision for a put that has one of at most 4,294,967,295, and absent after a revert on a snapshot with no entry; converged: source desired, in_force the version; refused: source and in_force as they were; failed: source desired for a put, baseline otherwise, no in_force; reverted: source baseline, no in_force; adopted: observed the adopted version, in_force too when it named the previous one, outcome, refusal and source kept; last_known true when the version acted on or adopted came from an archive and no owner's delivery of the same version confirmed it; call: source call, no in_force.

cases.note: a first put, acted on and converged (§2.6 step 2, §2.7)
a higher seq of the held run is acted on (step 3)
a lower seq of the held run is older, never acted on
an equal seq is the same version, received again
seqs compare as integers: 16,777,215 after 8,388,609 is higher, where serial order would not order them
a put with no envelope is ignored (step 1)
a delete with no envelope is ignored too
a put with no envelope, nothing held: still ignored, and the next is the first
another run is admitted, whatever its seq, and acted on (step 4)
an author's restart: the same document under a new run is adopted, and the report moves (step 5, §2.11)
a run of the other width with the same value is another run: adopted, and each is remembered apart
never an older version of a remembered run: the old run's lower seq, the new run held (step 4)
a remembered run's equal seq is the same version, whichever run is held

the residual, kept from v1: the old run's value in transit, its seq higher than any acted on, is admitted after the new run's first; the author's answer of the new run's version is then the same version, and its next put is acted on (§2.6)
remembered by adoption: a run whose version was adopted orders its later arrivals
sixteen remembered runs: after versions of sixteen runs, the first run's lower seq is older and its equal seq the same version
a delete heard, or read as a tombstone, reverts (§2.8)
a delete of a lower seq is older
a first delete, nothing held: admitted, and reverted
the author's delete made again under its new run: a delete after a delete, adopted (§2.11)
a put after a delete is acted on
a snapshot with no entry under the held run reverts, with no observed version (§2.8)
never under another run: the author restarted, and its new run's snapshot with no entry is no verdict
the held run's value at the other width is another run: no verdict
a snapshot with no entry, nothing held: no verdict
a snapshot of the held run built before the held version, its asof below the seq: older
after that revert, a put of the run at or below the asof is older, and one above it is acted on
after that revert, another run's put is acted on
after that revert, the delete itself arriving late, at or below the asof, is older; a delete of another run is adopted, and gives the report its version
a snapshot with no entry after a delete was acted on: nothing to revert, no verdict
a snapshot with no entry after a refused document, under its run: the refused version is the one held, so it reverts
a snapshot with no entry while an act runs waits, then reverts
under another run while an act runs: no verdict, and nothing waits
judged against the one held waiting too: a waiting put of the run above the asof makes it older
a put above the asof replaces a waiting snapshot with no entry; one at or below it is older
a delete past the window, then a restart: the target holds the old run's document, the new run answers no entry, and the document stays in force (§2.8, the residual)
a version that arrives while an act runs is held, then acted on (§2.7)
the latest replaces the one held waiting, which is passed over
older than the one held waiting is older; equal to it is the same version
another run replaces the one held waiting
the running act's version, delivered again, is the same version
a waiting version with the running act's document is adopted when the act ends
a refused document keeps the previous in force: in_force is another version (§2.7, §2.10)
refused from the baseline: nothing in force
a refused version is acted on once: delivered again, it is the same version
a refused document put again under a new run is adopted refused: observed moves, in_force stays
the next document after a refusal converges
a put applied in part: failed, source desired, nothing wholly in force
a revert that could not finish is failed, source baseline; a refusal of a revert is read as a failure
an archive's last-known is acted on, and reported so (§2.9)
the author's own sample of it confirms it: not acted again, last_known gone
confirmed while the act runs
an archive's equal delivery of an author's version is the same version, never a confirmation
an archive's stale last-known of a remembered run is older, the new run held
last-known, then the restarted author's put of the same document under a new run: adopted, last_known gone
an archive's tombstone reverts, last-known
a call: the target's own change since; the same version again is not acted on (§2.7, not a lock)
after a call, the same document under a new run is adopted, and the call stands
after a call, the next document is acted on
a restart acts again on the version its previous process acted on (§2.7)
a restart's first report is the baseline's
a restart forgets every run: the previous process's older version is acted on
a revision above 4,294,967,295 is refused whole, invalid, and the report carries no revision (§2.4)
a revision of 4,294,967,295 is the last one a document may carry
over a document in force, a revision above the bound keeps the previous in force
a document whose type carries no revision
a document as bytes, compared byte for byte: equal bytes under a new run are adopted
